theme_strategy.description: A high-end sports broadcast aesthetic. Avoid flat, generic 'admin panel' cards. Every match is an event. We achieve this through deep ink/navy backgrounds, sharp edges with subtle gold/colored accents, striking Barlow Condensed scores, and pronounced PNG crests with drop shadows.

headings_and_scores.usage: Match scores, time, status badges (LIVE, FT), matchday headers.

body_and_names.usage: Team names, referee details, pitch locations, metadata.

team_colors.usage: Use the team's primary color as a 4px accent line (e.g., left border of the tile) or a subtle 10% opacity radial gradient behind the team crest.

visual_enhancers.crests: Must use drop-shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] to pop against the dark backgrounds. If no crest, use a minimalist SVG placeholder with a white/20 fill.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders. Default: border-white/10. Hover: border-fsl-gold/40.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used sparingly for dropdowns/menus, not for the main tiles to maintain high contrast data legibility.

components.name: MatchTileGrid
components.description: Ultra-compact broadcast tile. Teams stacked vertically on the left, score/time massive on the right.
components.layout_classes: relative flex items-stretch bg-ink-950 border border-white/10 rounded-md overflow-hidden group hover:border-fsl-gold/40 transition-colors shadow-md
structure: 1. Dynamic Color Bar: `w-1.5 h-full` using Home Team's primary color.

2. Team Info Column (Left 75%): `flex flex-col justify-center space-y-1 p-2`. Two rows, each with `flex items-center space-x-2`. Crest (`w-4 h-4 object-contain drop-shadow`) + Team Name (`font-inter text-sm text-white font-semibold truncate`).

3. Score/Status Column (Right 25%): `flex flex-col items-end justify-center p-2 border-l border-white/5 bg-white/[0.02]`. Score (`text-2xl font-barlow-condensed font-black text-white leading-none`). Status (`text-[10px] font-bold uppercase` - red pulsing for LIVE, fsl-slate for FT).
4. Final Stage Indicator: If final stage, absolute top-right tiny gold ribbon or gold border-top.

admin_variants.conflict: Add absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none class `border-2 border-fsl-danger shadow-[inset_0_0_8px_rgba(239,68,68,0.4)]`
admin_variants.drag_drop: On hover, reveal a drag handle (6 dots, text-white/50) at the absolute left (over the color bar) and cursor-grab.
admin_variants.quick_edit: Team rows get `hover:bg-white/10 cursor-pointer` and a 12px pencil icon fades in on hover.

components.name: MatchCardList
components.description: Luxurious, expanded broadcast graphics. Symmetrical split or wide landscape layout.
components.layout_classes: fsl-card gold-skin relative w-full flex flex-col bg-gradient-to-br from-navy-800 to-ink-950 border border-white/10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden group hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_-10px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)] transition-all
structure: 1. Kicker/Header: `flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-2 bg-black/20 border-b border-white/5`. Left: Competition Name (`font-barlow-condensed text-sm font-bold text-fsl-gold tracking-widest`). Right: Match Status Badge.

2. Main Body: `flex items-center justify-between p-5`. Left & Right sides: `flex flex-col items-center w-1/3 space-y-2`. Crests are large (`w-10 h-10 drop-shadow-lg`). Team Names (`font-inter text-base font-bold text-white text-center`).
3. Center Score: `w-1/3 flex flex-col items-center justify-center`. Massive Result (`text-5xl font-barlow-condensed font-black text-white tabular-nums tracking-tighter`). Or vs/time if unplayed.
4. Footer: `flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 bg-black/40 text-xs font-inter text-fsl-slate`. Left: Date & Time. Right: Pitch & Referee.

motion.live_pulse: animate-pulse (opacity 1 to 0.5) applied to the red dot or LIVE text.
motion.drag_state: opacity-50 scale-95 ring-2 ring-fsl-gold (when dragged in admin)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure team color accent bars do not bleed into white text. Use text-shadow if placing text over team color blocks.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, match tiles, and edit buttons MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='match-tile-juve-milan', data-testid='admin-edit-home-team').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read the blueprint above to construct the `.fsl-card` and MatchTile components in React (using Javascript).
2. Strict Typography: Use Barlow Condensed ONLY for numbers, scores, and uppercase headers (kickers, matchdays). Use Inter for team names, metadata, and body.
3. Apply Broadcast aesthetic: Keep backgrounds dark (`navy-800`/`ink-950`). Do NOT use plain flat white/gray cards.
4. Implement the grid tile as a row-based layout (teams left, score right) to fit the 300x70px constraint elegantly.
5. For the Control Room grid, implement the `admin_variants` precisely (conflict states, drag handles, hover to edit).
6. Make sure you apply drop-shadow to crest PNGs so they do not look flat.
7. Include `data-testid` on all tiles and buttons.
8. Utilize the provided Tailwind colors: fsl-gold, fsl-slate, navy-800, ink-950, fsl-success, fsl-warning, fsl-danger.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Keep dark colors solid or use extremely subtle gradients (like 950 to 900).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders.
Never use generic centered layouts for complex data; left-align data unless symmetry is intentionally designed (like the MatchCardList body).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Always include data-testid for all interactive and key informational elements.
